selection: In each family, traverse JSON files in ascending (Git blob size, path); validate the original schema and source bytes; retain the first three eligible directed graph structures with 20..400 tasks, positive communication and no isomorphism to any prior v1/v2 graph or previously retained R6 graph. Inspect no scheduling outcome. Stop once three are retained per family; if insufficient, report incomplete rather than change the rule.
comparison_scope: Twelve new measured workflow instances from four previously unused families, structural holdout conditional on source corpus and eligibility; not a random sample of all workflows.
